propositions: Empty file_impact is semantically overloaded: it conflates author-forgotten declarations with genuinely-no-file-impact tickets, forcing conservative whole-HEAD invalidation in both cases

A tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared, paths, none) with required no_file_impact_reason for the none state enables the gate to distinguish between silence (conservative fallback) and explicit truthful claims (precise attestation scoping)

Explicit no-file-impact declarations must be part of the material fingerprint so state transitions invalidate the attestation and force re-review, preventing retroactive widening of attestation validity

Containers with mixed path-declaring and explicitly-no-file-impact children must inherit only the path-declaring children's union, removing the poison rule where a single undeclared child collapses the whole container to whole-HEAD scope
A plan-review criterion must deterministically fire only on the presence of an explicit no-file-impact assertion and judge its correctness against the plan using LLM evaluation
The no-file-impact declaration must round-trip through the reduced ticket state and be passed to the review criterion during judgment
